name: DQ Marunomi Ryona Battle 2 ~Chou Bitch na Haramase Kakutouka Hen~
original_name: DQ丸呑みリョナ・バトル2 〜超ビッチな孕ませ格闘家編〜
source:
Demon army vs. solitary human girl.
Unspeakable evil spilled from the bowels of hell into our realm.
They came to abduct and devour, slaughtering every last man.
Only women remained. And their leader is in the hands
of tantalizing lust... 

[from the [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081637.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
魔族大军VS孤独的人类少女。
无法形容的邪恶从地狱的深处蔓延到我们的领域。
他们来绑架和吞噬，屠杀每一个人。
只剩下女人了。而他们的领袖就在手中
充满着诱人的欲望……
